scope: Cold isolated native Expert probes including reached teacher transfers. Fixed small case settings; cylinder is the self-contained startup variation. No numerical accuracy, full-run capacity or paper/hardware speed claim. Synchronization can alter overlap and allocator reuse.

measurement.scope: Fresh disposable Expert time marching; complete native updates at the original horizon, including every teacher transfer actually reached. CUDA allocator phases include construction, window training and handoff; context initialization is excluded. Internal completed-window snapshots and frozen teachers are included. Profiling synchronization/bookkeeping overhead is included and can alter overlap/allocator reuse relative to uninstrumented execution.
excluded: final run checkpoint capture and transfer
later windows or schedules not reached
other processes and CUDA driver/context memory
measurement.peak_aggregation: CUDA overall peaks are maxima of sequential phase peaks, not sums. Phase allocator peaks include live state from earlier phases; CPU RSS is a cumulative process high-water mark, never a phase-local increment.
